words.gloss: in the proper way of life

literal: He who lives on earth in the way one ought to live, among the gods dwelling in heaven will be placed.
translation: He who lives his domestic life on earth as it should be lived will be counted among the gods who dwell in heaven.
modern: உலகத்தில் வாழ வேண்டிய நெறிமுறைப்படி வாழ்பவன், வானுலகத்தில் வாழும் தேவர்களுள் ஒருவனாக வைத்து மதிக்கப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the greatness of a householder who leads a righteous life. The author states that one who fulfills the duties of domestic life properly on earth does not need to seek divinity elsewhere; they are already equal to the gods dwelling in heaven. The key words 'வாழ்வாங்கு வாழ்பவன்' (he who lives as one ought to live) emphasize that the manner of living is more important than mere existence. Such a person is elevated to divine status, as indicated by 'தெய்வத்துள் வைக்கப்படும்' (will be placed among the gods).
